audience: Maintainers testing stateful recovery gates on normalized offline streams

target.selection: Existing small Python CLI is available and audited without a compiler, package install or live service. A replay/oracle/experiment wrapper is the gap; do not replace the upstream book core or build a general-purpose fuzzer.
target.scope: Python normalized teaching policy only; C++ and flat-depth experiment not evaluated. Source vendoring is limited to this exact public MIT runner and notice; upstream checkout remains unchanged.

oracle.independence: Pure bounded transition relation on accepted sequence and readiness, based on written REPLAY_CONTRACT.md and handwritten controls. No target import, target output as expected value, price-level implementation, or model verdict.
oracle.domain: At most 32 records: D; snapshots S q 100 5 200 5; positive bid updates U q B p z with 90<=p<=110 and 1<=z<=9; 1<=q<=1000. This domain excludes crossing, malformed lexical input and deletes, so oracle need not duplicate book price logic.
oracle.relation: Initially (q=0, ready=false). D preserves q and clears ready. A snapshot s>=q sets (s,true); s<q preserves q and clears ready. An update while not ready preserves (q,false); while ready, s<=q preserves (q,true), s=q+1 sets (s,true), s>q+1 preserves q and clears ready.
oracle.observations: Compare per-event reason, readiness and accepted sequence. On blocked/rejected events, also compare visible price/quantity tuple to the preceding accepted snapshot/update output as a relational atomicity check, not a full order-book correctness claim.
oracle.failure_identity: (target-version-and-variant, predicate-version, violated-clause). Distinct traces or seeds violating the same clause in the same variant are one identity, not more bugs.
oracle.harness_failures: Timeout, exit error, missing/extra/malformed output and digest mismatch are harness/adapter outcomes, not valid target bugs.

seeded_faults.scope: Controlled mutations of the pinned runner in isolated scratch files; original source bytes never edited.
seeded_faults.discovery_limit: Seeded artificial faults demonstrate benchmark sensitivity only. They are not new upstream bugs or independently discovered real vulnerabilities.

arms: recorded AI proposals through identical runner/oracle
comparison.equal_budget_rule: Same frozen target variants, oracle and execution opportunities per seed. Count every submitted candidate, including invalid/rejected proposals; never give AI unlimited retries. Report actual consumed opportunities and unfinished work.
comparison.generation_budget: No paid API/infra or external model execution is authorized by this contract. AI comparison is not executable until a fixed model/version, prompt, token ceiling, recorded token usage, wall time, inference price/cost and human assistance are present. Unknown generation cost cannot be declared equal or free.
comparison.splits: Freeze train/dev/holdout files and their provenance groups before any AI proposal. Group by recovery mechanism/provenance; forbid near-duplicate trace variants across groups and tuning on observed holdout results. Public holdout does not establish blind external evaluation.
metrics: failure replay success with explicit denominator
comparison.stop_rule: Record a valid negative result. If AI metadata/cost/budget or holdout independence is unavailable, stop/defer the AI experiment; never report an advantage from seeded fault detection or fixed baseline execution.

execution_policy.allowed_code: Pinned public runner plus three exact built-in mutation templates only; model text is data in the bounded grammar, never executed as Python or a shell command.
execution_policy.network: No adapter/network integration or network calls in the controlled runner; no claim of OS-enforced network isolation.
execution_policy.isolation: Fresh subprocess, fixed argv, isolated Python mode, timeout and bounded input/output. Hostile arbitrary-code execution, strong OS sandbox/memory enforcement and production security are outside the initial qualification and must not be implied.

CMP-01.state: CONSUMER_SCOPE_RECEIVED; owner profile/version artifact not yet audited
CMP-01.requirement: Preserve native freshness/finality/unknown observations when adding network targets.

CMP-03.state: CONSUMER_SCOPE_RECEIVED; owner profile/version artifact not yet audited
CMP-03.requirement: Preserve route trust configuration and native send/verify/execute/receive distinctions; a local book target is not cross-chain conformance.

CMP-04.state: CONSUMER_SCOPE_RECEIVED; owner manifest/version artifact not yet audited
CMP-04.requirement: Validate owner manifest version, source/license/revision/cutoff and input/code/config digests. Local G4 artifact schema must not be called the implemented CMP-04 contract.

complements.integration_rule: Contract/fixture dependencies, not simultaneous live services. Owner-controlled integration is a separate gate; do not change ownership or fabricate compatible owner schemas.

phase_status: P0 contract only. No new benchmark implementation, AI experiment, release, CI or independent reproduction is certified by this document.
